answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 44771 Country: Bangladesh Title: Change name Question: We have decided to keep her name Zahra Fatimah (I hope the spellings are correct). Is it fine if we keep Zahra Fatimah instead of Fatimah Zahra? As the last name is more frequently used and called more everywhere. Can you please reply as soon as possible as we have to correct her name in passport also? Answer ID: 44771 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 595/595/M=1434) It is good if you give the name of Fatimah Zahra to your daughter. But, there is no harm in keeping her name as Zahra Fatimah as well. It is also correct. The spelling is correct. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
